title: Magnets
statementMd:
Mad scientist Mike entertains himself by arranging rows of dominoes. He doesn't need dominoes, though: he uses rectangular magnets instead. Each magnet has two poles, positive (a "plus") and negative (a "minus"). If two magnets are put together at a close distance, then the like poles will repel each other and the opposite poles will attract each other.

Mike starts by laying one magnet horizontally on the table. During each following step Mike adds one more magnet horizontally to the right end of the row. Depending on how Mike puts the magnet on the table, it is either attracted to the previous one (forming a group of multiple magnets linked together) or repelled by it (then Mike lays this magnet at some distance to the right from the previous one). We assume that a sole magnet not linked to others forms a group of its own.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e92519e0975bb5b049acf707085aeb3fdda64d9f.png)

Mike arranged multiple magnets in a row. Determine the number of groups that the magnets formed.

## Input

The first line of the input contains an integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100000$) — the number of magnets. Then $*n*$ lines follow. The $*i*$-th line ($1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$) contains either characters "`01`", if Mike put the $*i*$-th magnet in the "plus-minus" position, or characters "`10`", if Mike put the magnet in the "minus-plus" position.

## Output

On the single line of the output print the number of groups of magnets.

## Note

The first testcase corresponds to the figure. The testcase has three groups consisting of three, one and two magnets.

The second testcase has two groups, each consisting of two magnets.
statementZhMd:
疯狂科学家 Mike 喜欢通过排列多米诺骨牌来娱乐自己。不过，他并不需要多米诺骨牌：他使用的是矩形磁铁。每块磁铁都有两个磁极，分别是正极（“加号”）和负极（“减号”）。如果将两块磁铁近距离放在一起，那么相同的磁极会相互排斥，而不同的磁极会相互吸引。

Mike 首先将一块磁铁水平放在桌面上。在接下来的每一步中，Mike 都会将另一块磁铁水平地放到这一排的最右端。根据 Mike 放置磁铁的方向，它可能会被前一块磁铁吸引（从而形成一个由多块磁铁连接而成的组），也可能会被前一块磁铁排斥（此时 Mike 会将这块磁铁放在距离前一块磁铁一定距离的右侧）。我们认为，一块没有与其他磁铁连接的磁铁也单独形成一个组。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e92519e0975bb5b049acf707085aeb3fdda64d9f.png)

Mike 将多块磁铁排列成一排。请确定这些磁铁形成了多少个组。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100000$）——磁铁的数量。接下来有 $*n*$ 行。第 $*i*$ 行（$1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$）包含字符串 "`01`" 或 "`10`"：如果 Mike 将第 $*i*$ 块磁铁以“正极-负极”的方向放置，则该行包含字符 "`01`"；如果 Mike 将其以“负极-正极”的方向放置，则该行包含字符 "`10`"。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出磁铁组的数量。

## 说明

第一个测试用例对应图中的情况。该测试用例中有三个组，分别由三块、一块和两块磁铁组成。

第二个测试用例中有两个组，每组包含两块磁铁。
